'''Cleanse Mind''' was a crucial [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that was employed by [[Jedi Consular]]s of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It allowed a member of the [[Jedi Consular]]s to negate an on-going mind-affecting [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] from themselves or an ally within their line of sight.<ref name="TFU CG" />
